descripcion: This is my server template! I created all of this myself. Please believe me!! @oikawasglasses#1301
An advanced support server, but with all the necessary features and resources. For help with setup, join the server.
See the #read-channel topic for more information. Log in to the server for help.

This template is designed for those who manage or plan to create a Minecraft server. It includes essential channels such as information, announcements, support, general chat, and server logs, as well as integration with the Minecraft console and chat. Organize your community efficiently and professionally from the start.

This template was created to make it easy to connect with your community and keep them informed about your posts. It includes dedicated sections for automatically sharing your new videos and streams on Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, and more, organized in a dedicated category.

This template is ideal for creating and managing a general Discord community. It includes organized channels for information, announcements, general chat, media, suggestions, support, and more. It's designed to provide a fluid experience and maintain clear communication between members.
